title: Murtabak
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Namak (Salt) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
Water 1 & ½ Cup or as required
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 tsp or to taste
Lal mirch (Red chilli) crushed ½ tsp
Zeera (Cumin seeds) roasted & crushed 1 & ½ tsp
Water ½ Cup or as required
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 1 tsp
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Hara dhania (Fresh coriander) chopped ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,salt,ghee,egg and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,namak,ghee aur anda dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until dough is formed,grease with melted ghee,cover & let it rest for 35-40 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein,melted ghee sa grease karein aur dhak ker 35-40 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a wok,add cooking oil,onion and saute until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent hunay tak saute ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken mince & mix well until it changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken qeema dal ker rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add turmeric powder,salt,red chilli powder,red chilli crushed,cumin seeds,green chillies,mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Haldee powder,namak,lal mirch powder,lal mirch crushed,zeera aur hari mirch dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well,cover & cook on low flame for 8-10 minutes then cook on high flame until dries up & let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein phir tez ancch per sukh janay tak paka lein & thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add eggs,black pepper powder,salt and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anda,kali mirch powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomato,green onion,fresh coriander & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar,hara pyaz aur hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Now add cooked chicken mince,mix well and set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab cooked chicken qeema shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease hands with melted ghee and knead dough again for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko melted ghee sa grease karein aur dough ko dubara 8-10 minutes kliya ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough (100g),make a ball and apply melted ghee and roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough (100g) lein aur ball bana lein,melted ghee laga ker rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken & egg mixture in the center of dough & fold all the sides (makes 8).
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken & egg mixture dal ker tamam sides ko fold ker lein (makes 8).

steps.instruction: On girddle,place paratha,brush melted ghee & fry on medium flame from all sides until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Tawa per paratha rakh ker melted ghee laga lein aur tamam sides sa darmiyani ancch per golden brown hunay tak ghee mein fry ker lein.
Desired pieces mein cut ker ka serve karein!
